core_insight.source_excerpt: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on observing the 'Work Graph' and leveraging existing foundation models to proactively identify and automate high-ROI opportunities for AI-first companies, rather than building new LLMs or relying on manual AI deployment.
core_insight.if_wrong: If enterprises cannot effectively observe work patterns, accurately detect intent/drift, or if automated agent deployment proves ineffective, then Narma will fail to deliver continuous AI lift and ROI, leading to low adoption.

raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to help AI-first companies implement AI automation effectively. This venture aims to solve the critical challenges enterprises face with AI adoption: lack of clear telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and behavioral/systemic drift that undermines AI initiatives. The core innovation lies in its three-layered approach: (1) an observation layer using desktop sensors to capture work patterns, (2) an intelligence layer ("Brain") to detect intent, business value, and drift, and (3) an execution layer ("Agent Factory") that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. Instead of building new large language models (LLMs), Narma leverages existing foundation models and focuses on mapping the "Work Graph" to identify areas where AI can provide immediate assistance and value. The target user is AI-first companies that need to operationalize and scale AI automation. The founder envisions a continuous AI lift for these companies by providing a system that observes work, decides AI actions, and auto-builds agents. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the founder aiming to build this comprehensive solution. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, given the ambition to provide a scalable "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to AI-first companies. This venture is positioning itself as a foundational layer that complements existing AI solutions and foundation models, enabling enterprises to derive tangible value and overcome the systemic hurdles of AI adoption.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's innovation lies in its comprehensive, layered approach to AI automation: using desktop sensors for granular work observation, an intelligent "Brain" to discern intent and drift, and an "Agent Factory" for automated, high-ROI AI agent deployment. This system differentiates itself by focusing on the "Work Graph" and leveraging existing foundation models, providing a continuous AI value stream rather than requiring enterprises to build their own AI infrastructure or manually identify automation opportunities.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. It operates in three layers: Observe (Layer 1) using lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns; Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) which is a "Brain" that detects employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift"; and an Execution Layer (Layer 3) with an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. The system utilizes existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify AI intervention points. The vision is a single system that observes, decides, and auto-builds agents for "Continuous AI lift."
